# Veil 0.16.2

Patch release for all ten Veil, Shield Swap, and Bridge packages, published
under npm's `latest` tag. The functional change is in
`@provablehq/aleo-bridge-sdk`; the other packages move in lockstep.

```sh
npm install @provablehq/aleo-bridge-sdk@latest
```

## Changes

- Add public ALEO ↔ BSC transfers through Verulink. The default registry
  declares both routes, pinned to the reviewed upstream deployment: the BSC
  contracts, the Aleo programs, the Verulink domains, and the token metadata.
- `quote` reads the bridge fee from contract state. `execute` submits the
  source transaction on either chain. `complete` retrieves the attestor
  signatures, verifies quorum and membership against the current attestor
  set, checks destination consumption, and claims on the destination chain.
  Screening that redirects funds to holding is reported separately from
  successful delivery.
- Prepared Aleo transactions are preserved in the checkpoint for recovery.
  An approval-only EVM checkpoint is ambiguous and is never resubmitted
  automatically.
- Registry checkpoints written by earlier releases still resume.
- Runnable examples cover a checkpointed Verulink round trip and
  bidirectional USDG transfers between Aleo and Ethereum or Solana. The
  bridge README, the examples README, and the site docs describe the new
  routes and the signer and fee requirements.

## Compatibility

No type, option, or export is removed. Peer ranges for `veil-aleo-devnode`,
`veil-aleo-sdk`, and `veil-aleo-wallet-adapter` move to `>=0.16.2 <1.0.0`.

## Validation

The feature PR completed a mainnet round trip on 2026-11-04 (20 ALEO to BSC
and back, with delivery verified on both chains) and passed live read-only
quotes in both directions. The root suite, the bridge build and typecheck,
the bridge examples typecheck, and the reference dApp typecheck pass on the
release branch. Packed peer ranges for `veil-aleo-devnode`, `veil-aleo-sdk`,
and `veil-aleo-wallet-adapter` resolve to `>=0.16.2 <1.0.0`.

Source: [feature PR #217](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/pull/217) and
[docs PR #218](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/pull/218).
